notes

Everyone belongs to somebody — I want to be yours. This album came about by accident. I had been playing guitar and writing songs for years. As the songs slowly got better and better, I decided to record a couple of them. Fast forward a year, and a friend of mine reached out to me about recording something in an actual studio. Fast forward another year, and I had 4-5 songs recorded. I reached out to that same friend, recorded a few more songs, and sent them off to him for some proper mixing. The result is this album — I Want to Be Yours and Other Songs. While a few of the tracks developed over years of playing and changes, most of them were written in less than ten minutes. I would have a riff in my hand and a thought would pop into my head. A few minutes later, I would have the words to a new song. A few of the songs (including the title track) were written during my first few months of fatherhood. Other songs are about stories I heard as a kid, the struggle to write and perform music, and thoughts that have been on my mind for a long time. I had such a great time putting this album together. I hope you enjoy it.
